<documents>
<document id="disputes-merchant-v2">
DisputingˆaˆpurchaseˆwithˆaˆmerchantˆIfˆyouˆpaidˆforˆsomethingˆwithˆyourˆcardˆandˆthere'sˆaˆproblemˆwithˆtheˆpurchaseˆitself,ˆyouˆcanˆfileˆaˆmerchantˆdispute.ˆThisˆcovers:ˆ-ˆItemsˆorˆservicesˆyouˆpaidˆforˆbutˆneverˆreceivedˆ-ˆItemsˆthatˆwereˆsignificantlyˆdifferentˆfromˆwhatˆwasˆdescribedˆ-ˆSubscriptionsˆorˆrecurringˆchargesˆthatˆcontinuedˆafterˆyouˆcancelledˆ##ˆContactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirstˆBeforeˆyouˆdispute,ˆtryˆtoˆsortˆitˆoutˆwithˆtheˆmerchant,ˆandˆkeepˆaˆrecordˆofˆwhatˆyouˆsentˆandˆwhatˆtheyˆsaid.ˆWe'llˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆHowˆlongˆyouˆhaveˆFileˆaˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwithinˆ120ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆweˆcan'tˆopenˆaˆdisputeˆforˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfileˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆProblemˆwithˆaˆpurchase.ˆTellˆusˆwhatˆhappenedˆandˆuploadˆyourˆrecords.ˆ##ˆWhatˆhappensˆnextˆIfˆtheˆdisputeˆpassesˆanˆinitialˆreview,ˆyouˆgetˆaˆprovisionalˆcreditˆwithinˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆthenˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆthroughˆtheˆcardˆnetwork.ˆMostˆcasesˆfinishˆwithinˆ45ˆdays.ˆTransactionsˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognizeˆatˆallˆareˆaˆdifferentˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆSeeˆ"Disputingˆaˆtransactionˆyouˆdidn'tˆmake".ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-documents">
DocumentsˆthatˆhelpˆaˆdisputeˆTheˆrightˆdocumentsˆmakeˆaˆdisputeˆfasterˆandˆmoreˆlikelyˆtoˆsucceed.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆhelpsˆforˆeachˆkindˆofˆdispute.ˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆreceivedˆ-ˆOrderˆconfirmationˆshowingˆtheˆexpectedˆdeliveryˆdateˆ-ˆTrackingˆinformation,ˆifˆanyˆ-ˆYourˆmessagesˆtoˆtheˆmerchantˆaskingˆaboutˆtheˆdeliveryˆ##ˆItemˆnotˆasˆdescribedˆ-ˆTheˆproductˆlistingˆorˆdescriptionˆ-ˆPhotosˆofˆwhatˆyouˆreceivedˆ-ˆProofˆyouˆreturnedˆitˆorˆofferedˆto,ˆifˆtheˆmerchantˆaskedˆ##ˆCancelledˆsubscriptionˆstillˆchargedˆ-ˆTheˆcancellationˆconfirmation,ˆorˆaˆscreenshotˆofˆtheˆdateˆyouˆcancelledˆ-ˆTheˆmerchant'sˆcancellationˆterms,ˆifˆyouˆhaveˆthemˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆUsuallyˆnothing.ˆJustˆconfirmˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆorˆauthorizeˆtheˆtransactionˆandˆthatˆyourˆcardˆisˆfrozenˆorˆreported.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆuploadˆOpenˆtheˆdisputeˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆDisputes,ˆandˆtapˆAddˆdocuments.ˆPhotosˆandˆPDFsˆwork.ˆNeverˆsendˆusˆyourˆfullˆcardˆnumber,ˆPINˆorˆpasswordsˆasˆpartˆofˆaˆdispute.ˆWeˆdon'tˆneedˆthem.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="plan-billing">
WhenˆandˆhowˆplanˆfeesˆareˆchargedˆPaidˆplanˆfeesˆareˆchargedˆonceˆaˆmonthˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdate,ˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆYourˆbillingˆdateˆisˆtheˆdayˆyouˆfirstˆjoinedˆaˆpaidˆplan,ˆorˆtheˆdayˆofˆyourˆlastˆupgrade.ˆ##ˆIfˆtheˆfeeˆcan'tˆbeˆcollectedˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆtooˆlowˆonˆtheˆbillingˆdate,ˆweˆtryˆagainˆafterˆ3ˆdays.ˆIfˆtheˆsecondˆtryˆalsoˆfails,ˆyourˆplanˆmovesˆtoˆBasic.ˆCushionˆneverˆcoversˆplanˆfees.ˆYouˆcanˆmoveˆbackˆtoˆaˆpaidˆplanˆonceˆyou'veˆaddedˆmoney.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆseeˆitˆTheˆchargeˆshowsˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆasˆ"Planˆfee"ˆwithˆtheˆplanˆname.ˆYourˆnextˆbillingˆdateˆisˆshownˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆ##ˆRefundsˆPlanˆfeesˆaren'tˆproratedˆandˆaren'tˆeligibleˆforˆgoodwillˆfeeˆrefunds.ˆTheˆonlyˆexceptionˆisˆtheˆcooling-offˆruleˆforˆyourˆfirstˆpaidˆplanˆcharge,ˆwhichˆgivesˆaˆfullˆrefundˆifˆyouˆleaveˆtheˆpaidˆplanˆwithinˆ14ˆdaysˆofˆthatˆcharge.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: I paid for a jacket that never arrived. What's the deadline to dispute it?
